name: Maou no Musume wa Chou Namaiki!!
original_name: 魔王の娘は超ナマイキ!!
source:
Dyuran - the Devil Queen's army commander and Vivi - daughter to the Devil Queen
After escaping with their lives from the ruinous kingdom, it's time to rebuild Her Majesty's army, but while Dyuran struggles Vivi leeches off the remaining soldiers' property and food supply.
"What's the point of taking over the Underworld if there's another war? Hmm?"
That brazen demonic bitch!
Dyuran is going to punish her for his wasted effort! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE066226.html]DLsite[/url]]
